solution_summary: Lawpath Reduces Customer Service Inquiries by 25% with Self-Service AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock Lawpath , an Australia-based online legal service born on Amazon Web Services (AWS), introduced Lawpath AI to automate legal tasks and enhance the customer experience by leveraging generative AI. Lawpath AI was developed using Anthropic Claude on Amazon Bedrock , incorporating Amazon EventBridge to trigger AWS Lambda workloads. With Lawpath AI on AWS offering a range of self-service legal solutions, Lawpath has reduced customer service inquiries by 25 percent, cut customer quote lead time from 3 days to half a day, and is now creating 15 percent more legal documents. Lawpath was born on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in 2014 and has taken a cloud-native approach to technology ever since.
